e.title: Loss Data Analytics
e.summary: 开放精算教材《Loss Data Analytics》（72★）：交互式在线损失数据教科书——非寿险精算核心训练
e.summary_en: Open actuarial textbook 'Loss Data Analytics' (72★): interactive online loss data text — core non-life actuarial training
e.summary_hk: 開放精算教材《Loss Data Analytics》（72★）：交互式在線損失數據教科書——非壽險精算核心訓練
e.body: Loss Data Analytics（OpenActTexts，72★）是交互式在线开放教材：损失数据精算的核心训练（分布、频率-严重度、GLM、准备金、可信度）——由多位学者合作（ISU/Waterloo 等）的现代精算教科书。对 RIAA：非寿险精算的开放教材——[[rim540]] 及课程的补充阅读；交互式（在线 R/Python 执行）教学形式；覆盖损失建模核心主题（与 [[insurance-severity]]、[[insurance-credibility]] 主题对应）；72★ 学术社区认可；适合自学与课程参考。
e.body_en: Loss Data Analytics (OpenActTexts, 72★) is an interactive, online, freely available textbook: core training in loss data actuarial science (distributions, frequency-severity, GLMs, reserving, credibility) — a modern actuarial textbook by collaborating scholars (ISU/Waterloo etc.). For RIAA: the open textbook of non-life actuarial science — supplementary reading for [[rim540]] and courses; interactive teaching format (online R/Python execution); covers core loss-modelling topics (matching [[insurance-severity]] and [[insurance-credibility]] themes); 72★ academic community recognition; suits self-study and course reference.
e.body_hk: Loss Data Analytics（OpenActTexts，72★）是交互式在線開放教材：損失數據精算的核心訓練（分佈、頻率-嚴重度、GLM、準備金、可信度）——由多位學者合作（ISU/Waterloo 等）的現代精算教科書。對 RIAA：非壽險精算的開放教材——[[rim540]] 及課程的補充閱讀；交互式（在線 R/Python 執行）教學形式；覆蓋損失建模核心主題（與 [[insurance-severity]]、[[insurance-credibility]] 主題對應）；72★ 學術社區認可；適合自學與課程參考。
